en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by fields and low hills. The town consists of compactly arranged houses with steep, tiled roofs and a prominent church with a bulbous (onion) tower rising above the settlement. The foreground shows ploughed farmland, and the background is hilly countryside. The upper sky area of the card appears damaged or overexposed, leaving a bright white band across the top portion of the image. There is no legible printed caption or handwriting visible.
